sections.Profile:
"World Beauties" is a 1960 pinball machine from D. Gottlieb & Co., designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1959
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Pageantry, Wood Rail, Card games
